"""P27 offline documentation audit; source retained in its JSON evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import collections, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/"tools"))
import package_claude as common
DOCS=["README.md","docs/user/README.md","docs/user/skills.md","docs/user/governance.md",
      "docs/user/memory.md","docs/user/security.md","docs/user/troubleshooting.md",
      "docs/user/walkthroughs.md","docs/developer/maintainer-guide.md","docs/release/marketplace-copy.md"]
def read(p): return (ROOT/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def data(p): return json.loads(read(p))
def git(*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git","-c","safe.directory="+ROOT.as_posix(),"-c","core.excludesFile=",*args],
       capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",cwd=ROOT)
    assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
    return r.stdout.strip()
report={"layer":"documentation_static_audit","started_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"command":sys.orig_argv,"shell_method":"PowerShell single-quoted here-string piped to python -B -",
"checks":[],"host_or_model_calls":0,"limitations":"Selected document/link/hash/record properties, not agent behavior, full schema validation or proof of every semantic claim."}
def passed(id,observed): report["checks"].append({"id":id,"status":"PASS","observed":observed})
def audit():
    assert all((ROOT/p).is_file() for p in DOCS)
    walk=read("docs/user/walkthroughs.md")
    cases=re.split(r"^## (WT-\d{2})[^\n]*\n",walk,flags=re.M)
    assert cases[1::2]==[f"WT-{n:02}" for n in range(1,10)]
    for case in cases[2::2]:
        assert "Exact input:" in case and "Expected:" in case and "Evidence to capture:" in case
        assert "Observed result: NOT_RUN" in case and "Contract:" in case
    guide=read("docs/user/skills.md")
    slugs=set(common.SKILLS)
    assert set(re.findall(r"\.\./\.\./src/kiyo/skills/([a-z]+)/SKILL.md",guide))==slugs
    for path in ("src/kiyo/skills","dist/claude/skills","dist/codex/kiyo-compass/skills","dist/copilot/kiyo-compass/skills"):
        assert {p.parent.name for p in (ROOT/path).glob("*/SKILL.md")}==slugs
    passed("P27-A01","10 public/maintainer/draft documents; 9 separated NOT_RUN walkthroughs; guides link exactly eight Skills, matching source and all packages")

    readme=read("README.md")
    rows=[l for l in readme.splitlines() if l.startswith("| ") and ("CLI |" in l or "VS Code |" in l or "IDE Extension |" in l)]
    assert len(rows)==6
    assert all(any(s in l for s in ("NOT_TESTED","UNSUPPORTED")) for l in rows)
    assert "UNSUPPORTED" in next(l for l in rows if "Codex IDE" in l)
    records=[data("docs/evidence/live/"+s+".json") for s in ("claude-cli","claude-vscode","codex-cli","codex-ide","copilot-cli","copilot-vscode")]
    assert collections.Counter(c["execution_status"] for r in records for c in r["checks"])=={"PASS":2,"NOT_RUN":70}
    assert all(r["model"]=="NOT_INVOKED" and r["full_behavioral_suite"]=="NOT_TESTED" for r in records)
    assert all(c["result"]=="NOT_RUN" for c in data("docs/evidence/behavioral/observations.json")["records"])
    passed("P27-A02","Six separate support rows retain gaps; underlying 72 live records remain 2 PASS/70 NOT_RUN and 48 behavioral cases NOT_RUN")

    copy=read("docs/release/marketplace-copy.md")
    manifests=[data(p) for p in ("platforms/claude/.claude-plugin/plugin.json","platforms/codex/plugin.json","platforms/copilot/plugin.json")]
    for manifest in manifests:
        assert manifest["name"]=="kiyo-compass" and "version" not in manifest
        assert manifest["description"] in copy
    interface=manifests[1]["extensions"]["com.openai"]["interface"]
    assert all(interface[k] in copy for k in ("displayName","shortDescription","category"))
    assert interface["defaultPrompt"][0] in copy
    assert all(s in copy for s in ("NOT SUBMITTED","UNSET","DEC-001","DEC-002"))
    passed("P27-A03","Draft identity/descriptions/interface match real manifests; version unset and publication gates retained")

    inv=data("docs/evidence/packaging/artifact-inventory.json")
    for p,digest in inv["inputs"].items(): assert sha(p)==digest,p
    for p,digest in inv["tooling_sha256"].items(): assert sha(p)==digest,p
    for package in inv["packages"].values():
        assert sha("dist/archives/"+package["archive"])==package["archive_sha256"]
    assert not git("diff","--name-only","HEAD","--","src","platforms","tools","tests","dist","LICENSE")
    assert git("hash-object","LICENSE")=="d2e60c5b160ed4f9ca096215e72efee5769936b1"
    passed("P27-A04",f"{len(inv['inputs'])} allowlisted input hashes, packaging tooling, three ZIP hashes and original LICENSE preserved; no product/tool/test/package diff")

    files=[ROOT/"README.md"]+[p for folder in ("docs","src","tests","platforms","dist") for p in (ROOT/folder).rglob("*.md")]
    texts={p.resolve():p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in files}
    anchors={p:{common.slug(m[1]) for m in re.finditer(r"^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*$",t,re.M)} for p,t in texts.items()}
    links=0
    errors=[]
    for path,text in texts.items():
        if "\ufffd" in text or "\x00" in text or re.search(r"^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)",text,re.M):
            errors.append([str(path),"invalid text/conflict marker"])
        common.reject_links(path)
        base=path
        rel=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        for target in ("claude","codex","copilot"):
            if rel==f"platforms/{target}/resources/activation.md":
                folder="dist/claude" if target=="claude" else f"dist/{target}/kiyo-compass"
                base=ROOT/folder/"skills/init/references"/target/"activation.md"
        body=re.sub(chr(96)*3+r"[\s\S]*?"+chr(96)*3,"",text)
        for match in common.LINK.finditer(body):
            dest=match[1].strip().strip("<>")
            if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:",dest): continue
            filename,_,anchor=dest.partition("#")
            target=(base.parent/filename).resolve() if filename else base
            if not target.is_relative_to(ROOT) or not target.exists():
                errors.append([rel,dest,"missing/escaping"]); continue
            parent=ROOT
            for part in target.relative_to(ROOT).parts:
                if part not in {p.name for p in parent.iterdir()}:
                    errors.append([rel,dest,"case mismatch"]); break
                parent=parent/part
            if anchor and anchor not in anchors.get(target,set()): errors.append([rel,dest,"anchor"])
            links+=1
    assert not errors,errors
    passed("P27-A05",{"markdown_files":len(files),"local_inline_links":links,"scope":"Contained exact-case paths and heading anchors; external links not re-fetched by this script; adapters rebased to shipped location"})

    ids=[f"REQ-{n:03}" for n in range(1,81)]
    assert re.findall(r"^## (REQ-\d{3})$",read("docs/build/REQUIREMENTS.md"),re.M)==ids
    rows=[[v.strip() for v in l.split("|")[1:-1]] for l in read("docs/build/TRACEABILITY.md").splitlines() if re.match(r"^\| REQ-\d{3} \|",l)]
    assert [r[0] for r in rows]==ids and all(len(r)==10 and r[8]=="NOT_RUN" for r in rows)
    assert collections.Counter(r[7] for r in rows)=={"PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED":79,"NOT_IMPLEMENTED":1}
    assert not git("diff","--cached","--name-only") and git("branch","--show-current")=="main"
    assert git("rev-parse","HEAD")=="b422d201c4dae8aa29963a8f7753583862f0c86a"
    for path in (".kiyo","AGENTS.md","AGENTS.override.md","CLAUDE.md",".vscode",".github"): assert not (ROOT/path).exists(),path
    assert read("docs/build/TRACEABILITY.md").count("[P27 documentation evidence]")==8
    assert "| 27 | Documentation | DONE |" in read("docs/build/PROGRESS.md")
    assert "| 28 | Release Tooling | NOT_STARTED |" in read("docs/build/PROGRESS.md")
    assert "**Next: Prompt 28 Release Tooling**" in read("docs/build/HANDOFF.md")
    for name,prefix,count in (("OPEN-ISSUES","ISS",9),("DECISIONS","DEC",4)):
        assert re.findall(r"^\| ("+prefix+r"-\d{3}) \|",read(f"docs/build/{name}.md"),re.M)==[f"{prefix}-{n:03}" for n in range(1,count+1)]
    expected={"docs/build/"+n+".md" for n in ("BASELINE","DECISIONS","HANDOFF","OPEN-ISSUES","PROGRESS","TRACEABILITY")}
    expected.update({"docs/compatibility/native-invocation-map.md","docs/research/SOURCES.md"})
    assert set(git("diff","--name-only").splitlines())==expected
    fresh=git("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard").splitlines()
    assert all(p=="README.md" or p.startswith(("docs/user/","docs/developer/","docs/release/","docs/evidence/documentation/")) for p in fresh)
    git("diff","--check")
    passed("P27-A06","80 unique requirements/full NOT_RUN; eight scoped trace additions; nine issues/four decisions retained; next28; expected documentation-only diff; clean index/unchanged main HEAD; no project Memory/bootstrap/config; git diff --check passes")
try:
    audit()
    report.update(result="PASS",exit_code=0)
except Exception as error:
    report.update(result="FAIL",exit_code=1,failure=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
report["finished_at"]=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
report["document_sha256"]={p:sha(p) for p in DOCS}
report["git_status"]=git("status","--short")
report["audit_source"]=AUDIT_SOURCE
report_path=ROOT/"docs/evidence/documentation/audit-02.json"
report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with report_path.open("x",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n") as handle:
    json.dump(report,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); handle.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
sys.exit(report["exit_code"])
